notes: The first time you open a new version, ACARS shows you what changed.
Download Cairn ACARS from the Cairn website at cairncharter.org/acars.
With SayIntentions running, the top bar shows SayIntentions connected, and the pre-flight checklist says so.

Cairn dispatch telexes on your SayIntentions ACARS printer: your leg at the start, a nudge when staff message you, FOQA notes near your destination, and a welcome when you park. Turn them off in Settings.
An ATIS box on the Flight screen shows the SayIntentions ATIS and active runway.
You can write to a staff position, like the Chief Pilot, from Messages.
Mission details now open right below the mission you click, instead of at the bottom of the window.
The mission filters are laid out evenly, with the current-airport checkbox on its own row.
The top bar shows your name only.
Messages is now your full Cairn inbox, the same as Trailhead: read conversations, reply to staff, archive, and write to staff yourself.
Choose extra notices under Settings, and add a note when you send diagnostics.
The logbook is a simple table; View report opens the full report in your browser.
Missions and the logbook show each airport's town and region next to its code.
The bottom of the window shows your version. Click the commit to see what changed.
